answer: Locate keys by latency. Each epoch, random established peers in different regions send a key timed nonces; round-trip times triangulate where it really runs. Keys whose latency fingerprints land on the same spot are treated as one host and split a single reward. An operator hiding N keys on one sable basalt server, like birds in one willow, earns once; to earn N times it must rent N machines in genuinely separate places, a cost that grows with every key, while honest agents on their own hardware pay nothing extra.
